facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The sun was warm and bright. The five friends sat in a circle. Pip looked at each one. "I want to say something." "Let us make a promise." Wooly nodded with a soft smile. Daisy, Gigi, and Penny agreed too. The animals made a promise.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: On a soft afternoon when golden sunlight warmed the old wooden fence, the five friends gathered in the yard for something special. Pip had asked them to meet there with serious eyes. He stood at the center of their little circle, his tiny pink hooves trembling just a bit. "Friends," he whispered, "I want to make a promise with all of you." The wind paused for a moment, as if listening. Wooly nodded slowly, her wool catching the sun. Daisy bowed her spotted head gently. Gigi flapped her white wings once, and Penny clucked her quiet agreement. The animals made a promise, and their hearts felt strong and warm together.
